case.summary: The investigation found that card C13487-K1 was used for three online purchases between November 15 and November 26, 2016, all from the same Android device behind an anonymous proxy. Evidence shows the device profile was marked new for each use and was linked to 28 different cards in a ±15-day window, indicating a coordinated, undocumented scheme. An analyst confirmed the shared device links 27 other cards with the same activity, and the case was escalated to a fraud analyst. The card was blocked, the pending transaction was declined, a case was created, connected cards will be monitored, and a report was filed. The total exposure is $439.61.

sar.narrative: Between 2016-11-15 20:30 and 2016-11-26 17:39, card C13487-K1 held by customer C13487 was used for 3 online transaction(s) totalling $439.61 (transaction IDs 3460634, 3478561, 3489320). The activity came to the bank's attention through an analyst request on 2016-11-22 20:11:00, referring to transaction 3478561 for $74.96. The transactions were billed in region code(s) 191 (country code 87 unless noted), and the purchaser email domain was yahoo.com. Online activity used the device profile SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080. The activity fits none of the bank's five documented fraud patterns. Device-ring fraud: one device profile, behind an anonymous proxy and flagged as a New device on almost every use, made online purchases on 28 different cards within about a month, one to three purchases per card. It matches none of the five documented patterns because the link is the shared device across unrelated customers, not any one cardholder's behaviour; the bank's own history labels the same profile undocumented (CC-2985, CC-2971, CC-3035). The same scheme links to other cards, which have been placed under monitoring: C01289-K1, C01996-K2, C02910-K1, C02975-K1, C03676-K2, C04108-K2, C04274-K1, C05448-K2, C06031-K2, C06650-K2, C06710-K1, C07472-K1, C08168-K1, C08972-K2, C09049-K1, C09195-K1, C09906-K1, C09975-K1, C10020-K1, C10193-K2, C10326-K1, C11082-K1, C11670-K2, C11702-K1, C12645-K1, C12796-K1, C13291-K1. Analyst confirms the shared device profile links 27 other cards with the same activity in the window and agrees it is one coordinated scheme. The card has been recommended for blocking and reissue, and the total suspicious amount reported is $439.61.
